recipes.name: Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module
recipes.description: Assemble and calibrate a 0.4 kg Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module for a Polaris navigation station from 1 kg of electronics; retain 0.6 kg of offcuts. Docking requires a separate Dock action and docking clearance. Includes local avoidance of tracked contacts.

recipes.name: Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module
recipes.description: Rebuild two Polaris course plot modules and four small electronic parts into a 0.4 kg Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module for a Polaris navigation station, leaving four 0.6 kg board offcuts. Docking requires a separate Dock action and docking clearance. Includes local avoidance of tracked contacts.

recipes.name: Phobos' Asterel N2 Polaris Pursuit Module
recipes.description: Assemble a 0.4 kg pursuit module from 1 kg of electronics and retain 0.6 kg of board offcuts. Rendezvous and Follow; weapons require the separate N3 Fire Control System.

recipes.name: Phobos' Asterel N2 Polaris Pursuit Module
recipes.description: Rebuild three Polaris course plot modules and two small electronic parts into a 0.4 kg pursuit module, leaving three 0.6 kg board offcuts. Rendezvous and Follow; weapons require the separate N3 Fire Control System.

recipes.name: Phobos' Asterel N3 Polaris Fire Control System
recipes.description: Assemble a 0.4 kg fire control system from 1 kg of electronics and retain 0.6 kg of board offcuts. Choose a limited number of volleys and optional RCS aiming. Weapon firing permissions still apply.

recipes.name: Phobos' Asterel N3 Polaris Fire Control System
recipes.description: Rebuild three Polaris course plot modules and two small electronic parts into a 0.4 kg fire control system, leaving three 0.6 kg board offcuts. Choose a limited number of volleys and optional RCS aiming. Weapon firing permissions still apply.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline D4-S Dismantling Fixture Assembly Section
recipes.description: Build one 80 kg, 4 x 4 assembly section. Two sections make a complete powered dismantling fixture. Sections are unpowered construction stock, not working machinery.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline D4 Dismantling Fixture
recipes.description: Join two 80 kg assembly sections into a 160 kg, 4 x 4 industrial fixture. Accepts up to four ordinary loose wall panels and recovers parts, scrap and retained residue. Controls: F9 by default while beside the installed fixture, or F3: phobosshipbreaker help.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline H4 Sealed Hull Chute
recipes.description: Build a 40 kg, 4 wide x 1 deep transfer chute. Mount OVER four intact hull walls between a Phobos grabber outside and processor inside. Retain the walls; the chute does not replace them.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline H4 Sealed Hull Chute
recipes.description: Build a 40 kg, 4 wide x 1 deep transfer chute around a 2x bulkhead bin. Mount OVER four intact hull walls between a Phobos grabber outside and processor inside. Retain the walls; the chute does not replace them.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline G4 Exterior Grabber
recipes.description: Build an 80 kg, 4 wide x 3 deep exterior grabber. Place its rear against the wall chute and connect power. Load detached ordinary walls through Inventory, or prepare an owned, empty target and use Start reclamation for powered wall cutting. The connected D4 needs cooling.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline G4 Exterior Grabber
recipes.description: Build an 80 kg, 4 wide x 3 deep exterior grabber. A cryo distribution pump drives its clamps and a laser torch charging station powers its cutting head. Place its rear against the wall chute and connect power. Load detached ordinary walls through Inventory, or prepare an owned, empty target and use Start reclamation for powered wall cutting. The connected D4 needs cooling.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline C2 Residue Collector
recipes.description: Build a 20 kg, 2 wide x 1 deep collector. Place on structural floor with a clear service side, or over two intact exterior walls. Link a processor that touches it or shares a conveyor belt with it. Holds four 13 kg residue packets; cargo stays aboard. Needs separate conduit power.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline C2 Residue Collector
recipes.description: Build a 20 kg, 2 wide x 1 deep collector. An air vent becomes its gate and a 1 x 1 rack holds the packets. Place on structural floor with a clear service side, or over two intact exterior walls. Link a processor that touches it or shares a conveyor belt with it. Holds four 13 kg residue packets; cargo stays aboard. Needs separate conduit power.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline R4-S Scrap Reclaimer Assembly Section
recipes.description: Build one 90 kg, 4 x 4 unpowered section. Two sections make a complete enclosed scrap reclaimer.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline R4 Scrap Reclaimer
recipes.description: Join two 90 kg sections into a 180 kg, 4 x 4 reclaimer. Processes identified panel residue into steel, aluminium and retained rejects. Control Panel opens the feed and controls; ordinary Inventory holds products. Requires a cool room atmosphere and separate electrical conduit.

recipes.name: Phobos' Asterel C1 Industrial Control Console
recipes.description: Build a 40 kg, 3 x 3 seated workstation to control installed equipment on your own ship. Needs a separate 80 W power connection. Crew still load cargo, collect products and do maintenance beside each machine.

recipes.name: Phobos' Asterel C1 Industrial Control Console
recipes.description: Build a 40 kg, 3 x 3 seated workstation from a computer terminal, a small ship battery that steadies its supply and two Polaris map controls modules for its command boards. It controls installed equipment on your own ship. Needs a separate 80 W power connection. Crew still load cargo, collect products and do maintenance beside each machine.

recipes.name: Finish aluminium machinery housing
recipes.description: Finish one 19 kg casting into an 18 kg housing and one 1 kg aluminium offcut.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline D4-S Dismantling Fixture Assembly Section
recipes.description: Optional cast-housing route: one 18 kg housing supplements steel, aluminium, mechanisms and electronics. The existing recipe remains available.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline R4-S Scrap Reclaimer Assembly Section
recipes.description: Optional cast-housing route: one 18 kg housing and standard parts produce a 90 kg R4 section. The existing recipe remains available.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline F6-S Furnace Assembly Section
recipes.description: Build one 80 kg F6 section. Three sections make the full 240 kg furnace.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline F6 Electric Furnace
recipes.description: Join three 80 kg F6 sections into a 240 kg, 6 x 6 electric furnace. Requires one paired cooling assembly: exterior radiator or underside thermal port.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline F6-R Exterior Radiator
recipes.description: Build the 100 kg, 6 x 4 exterior F6 radiator. Mount outside on six intact hull walls.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline F6-R Exterior Radiator
recipes.description: Build the 100 kg, 6 x 4 exterior F6 radiator around two cryo distribution pumps, which drive its coolant. Mount outside on six intact hull walls.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline F6-P Thermal Exhaust Port
recipes.description: Build a complete 100 kg underside radiator assembly with a sealed 1 x 1 deck fitting. Mount beside the F6 on an intact sealed floor; the floor remains the pressure barrier.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline F6-P Thermal Exhaust Port
recipes.description: Build a complete 100 kg underside radiator assembly around two cryo distribution pumps, with a sealed 1 x 1 deck fitting. Mount beside the F6 on an intact sealed floor; the floor remains the pressure barrier.

recipes.name: Recover aluminium from housing blank
recipes.description: Cut one unused 19 kg housing blank into 19 kg of identified aluminium scrap. All cuttings are retained; this destroys the casting. Cold released castings only, never melt remainder or historic residue.

recipes.name: Recover aluminium from finished housing
recipes.description: Cut one unused 18 kg finished housing into 18 kg of identified aluminium scrap. All cuttings are retained; this destroys the casting. Cold released castings only, never melt remainder or historic residue.

recipes.name: Phobos' Rivetline F6-C Sealed Coolant Conduit
recipes.description: Build a 1 kg twin-channel conduit jacket and sealed couplings from one aluminium scrap. Supply and return share the route; no loose water is produced.

recipes.name: Recover aluminium from ingot
recipes.description: Cut one 4 kg aluminium ingot into 4 kg of identified aluminium scrap. All cuttings are retained; this destroys the ingot and loses its value.

recipes.name: Recover steel from ingot
recipes.description: Cut one 4 kg steel ingot into 4 kg of identified steel scrap. All cuttings are retained; this destroys the ingot and loses its value.
